sovereign_country.strategic_role: 海湾阿拉伯国家自贸走廊、外资100%控股与印度洋海运枢纽

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Open-Market Brokerage of Solid-State Drives and Server Processors

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Oman — Unitary National Jurisdiction (no sub-state tax or licensing distinction)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid: Civil Law enacted by Royal Decrees, with Islamic Sharia as a principal source; commercial matters are codified under the Commercial Companies Law, Royal Decree 18/2019
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Oman-United States Free Trade Agreement (in force since 2009)
Bilateral Investment Protection and Promotion Agreements with Germany, France, United Kingdom, India, China, Egypt, Turkey and other states
Double Taxation Avoidance Agreements with over 40 jurisdictions (including France, India, United Kingdom and Malaysia)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law on Combating Money Laundering and Combating the Financing of Terrorism, Royal Decree No. 30/2016 (as amended); Commercial Companies Law, Royal Decree No. 18/2019; Commercial Register Law, Royal Decree No. 3/1974 (as amended); Central Bank of Oman AML/CFT implementing Rules and Financial Intelligence Unit directives; Oman is a member of MENAFATF and a FATF associate member
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access — beneficial ownership data is filed confidentially with the Commercial Register and disclosed to licensed KYC parties, courts and the Financial Intelligence Unit upon lawful demand; no public UBO register exists

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation of the foreign sole shareholder (corporate UBO chain)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registry of the shareholder's home jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Oman is a contracting party to the Hague Apostille Convention) or, in the alternative, Consular Legalization at the Embassy of the Sultanate of Oman

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing of the foreign sole shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registry of the shareholder's home jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Passport copies and proof of residential address of every Ultimate Beneficial Owner and corporate signatory
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public of the country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter confirming provenance of corporate funds

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all shareholders, signatories and Ultimate Beneficial Owners against the UN Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, HM Treasury sanctions, EU consolidated sanctions and domestic Omani/CBO designations; screening must be completed before trade name clearance and refreshed at bank onboarding; PEP status automatically triggers Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) pursuant to Royal Decree 30/2016 and CBO AML/CFT instructions

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Invest Easy — the integrated licensing and trade name portal of the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (https://investeasy.gov.om)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Every Omani company must hold an Arabic trade name; a Latin-script transliteration is permitted solely for foreign correspondence and must exactly mirror the registered Arabic style. The name must include the legal-form identifier (SPC for a Single Person Company) and may not misrepresent the licensed activity of wholesale and open-market brokerage of solid-state drives and server processors
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the trade name is rejected, the applicant may file an administrative objection through the Invest Easy portal within 15 working days of the rejection notice; if the objection is dismissed, the decision may be appealed to the commercial administrative court within 30 days. Alternatively, the applicant may re-file under an amended trade name with a fresh reservation fee. An initial name reservation is not automatically extended but may be renewed once for an additional fee where supported by ongoing incorporation steps

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permissible for initial SPC licensing and Commercial Register filing: a leased physical or serviced office inside Oman with visible company signage and floor area consistent with the declared storage-distribution activity is required; virtual or P.O. Box-only arrangements are rejected
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Medium-to-High: unannounced onsite inspections by MOCIIP inspectors are estimated at 55% probability within the first 12 months for this Medium-Risk Enhanced trading scope; inspectors may verify physical premises, signage, inventory plausibility and personnel presence

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Trade name clearance and reservation fee under the Commercial Names Regulation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (Invest Easy portal)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Commercial Register incorporation filing for Single Person Company (SPC)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion — Commercial Registry

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Arabic translation of constitutional documents and supporting certificates
Notarization of SPC Memorandum/Articles and powers of attorney before an Omani notary public
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary Public — Ministry of Justice and Legal Affairs

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Hague Apostille or consular legalization of foreign UBO and corporate documents (bundle of four documents)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Home-jurisdiction competent authority and/or Embassy of the Sultanate of Oman
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Consular fee schedule and market benchmark of approximately USD 30 per document

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Mandatory UBO and PEP/sanctions screening (UN, OFAC, EU, HMT and domestic Omani lists)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Flat market rate for enhanced due diligence screening package

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered office confirmation and commercial address documentation (first year)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed serviced office provider or landlord in Oman
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for business addresses (OMR 185 average)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Professional incorporation agent and pre-filing due diligence legal fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Omani corporate service provider or law firm
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for a foreign-owned SPC in wholesale semiconductor trading

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Oman Commercial Companies Law, Royal Decree 18/2019 (as amended), particularly articles setting out Single Person Company formation, governance, and registration; read together with the Executive Regulations issued by MoCIIP.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MoCIIP) – Companies Registration Department, operating through the Invest in Oman and Sanad portals.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Incorporation Application accompanied by Notarized Articles of Association (AOA/MOA) in Arabic.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for an SPC under RD 18/2019; the AOA must declare an adequate capital, and the paid-up amount must be deposited into a temporary bank/escrow account in Oman, evidenced by a bank certificate before incorporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED THAT: 1. The subscriber, as sole shareholder of Oman SPC, approves the incorporation pursuant to Articles of Association submitted to MoCIIP and subscribes to one hundred ordinary shares of the initial paid-up capital. 2. The registered office is established at [address in Oman] and filed with the Commercial Register. 3. [Name] is appointed as Director and [Name] as General Manager, with authority to execute incorporation filings, open bank accounts, and engage advisors. 4. The Director and General Manager are authorized severally to file all statutory returns, pay fees, and obtain all municipal, environmental, and civil defense approvals necessary to commence wholesale trade.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MoCIIP – Invest in Oman / Sanad unified portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit up to three proposed trade names (Arabic or English) through the portal. The system will run a conflict screen against the commercial names register. Upon approval, download the name reservation certificate which is valid for a limited period and must be attached to the incorporation application.
required_dossiers: Power of attorney, if submitting through an authorized agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected for similarity, resubmit with alternate proposed names or file an appeal with the MoCIIP name committee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Notarization of Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MoCIIP authorized notary / authenticated by the Commercial Registrar
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Articles of Association in Arabic, setting out the SPC's legal form, share capital, principal object covering ISIC 4651 (wholesale of computers and peripheral equipment, including SSDs and processors), registered office address, and director details. All subscribers must sign in person or by notarized attorney before the notary. The notary will issue an authenticated signed copy for filing.
required_dossiers: Passport copies of shareholder and directors
Lease contract or ownership title for registered office
Bank certificate of paid-up capital deposit
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct any notarial remarks and re-serve the document; if the notary rejects the lease title, provide a duly attested tenancy contract or amended address declaration.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening Temporary Bank Escrow Account and Capital Deposit
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial bank licensed by the Central Bank of Oman
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Use the name reservation certificate and draft AOA to open a temporary SPC account. Deposit the declared paid-up capital and request a capital certificate confirming the amount and the account holder's name. This certificate must be submitted with the incorporation application.
required_dossiers: Passport copies of shareholder and signatories
Brief business plan or company object statement
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requests additional KYC, provide board or shareholder resolutions and source-of-funds evidence; refile for fresh certificate once the account is funded.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MoCIIP – Companies Registration Department via Invest in Oman portal / Sijilat integration
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the electronic incorporation application and attach the notarized AOA, capital certificate, lease contract, name reservation certificate, and identification documents. Pay the statutory registration fee online. After approval by MoCIIP, the Commercial Registration (CR) and unified number are issued electronically.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried, respond through the portal within 14 calendar days with corrected documents or additional attestations; pay any resubmission or administrative penalty, then upload the correction file.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration and Chamber of Commerce Membership
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Oman Tax Authority (OTA) and Oman Chamber of Commerce and Industry (OCCI)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register with the Oman Tax Authority for corporate income tax using the newly issued CR number; also complete the VAT registration process if taxable supplies exceed the mandatory threshold, otherwise consider voluntary registration. Obtain the OCCI membership card by filing the CR and lease documents and paying the membership fee.
required_dossiers: CR transaction number from Invest in Oman
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If OTA rejects registration, correct company name or CR reference and resubmit through the Tawasul system; for OCCI, present an updated CR extraction and unblock the account.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal, Civil Defense and Occupational Premises Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Municipality (e.g. Muscat Municipality) and Civil Defence and Ambulance Authority (CDAA)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for the municipal commercial license (Sijil Tijari) and, where applicable, a warehouse license for the office/storage location. Submit the lease, CR, and floor plan to CDAA for a fire safety inspection. Pass any physical inspection of the site to obtain the occupational workplace clearance and, for warehouse premises, a structural load assessment if racking is installed.
required_dossiers: Structural load calculation for storage racks
Waste management/food safety declaration, if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If CDAA imposes corrections, complete the required fire alarm/extinguisher upgrades, schedule a re-inspection, and pay the inspection fee; for municipal queries, amend the land-use classification to commercial/wholesale and refile.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable for industrial production; commercial licensing is handled by the relevant Municipal Licensing Department, and any warehousing is governed by the municipality's commercial premises regulations.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Municipal Commercial License (Sijil Tijari) and, if applicable, a Municipal Warehouse Storage License.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environment Authority of the Sultanate of Oman
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt from mandatory EIA Report; wholesale electronic component trading is a Category 3 (low impact) activity. Only an environmental self-assessment or notification may be required for the office/storage site.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial process wastewater, VOCs, or stack emissions are generated. Domestic sewage must meet Omani sewerage standards. Discarded SSDs and CPUs are e-waste and must be handled through licensed recyclers under Oman's Waste Management Regulations.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Mandatory CDAA fire safety certificate for the office and any storage area; structural engineer inspection for racking loads; and Ministry of Labour occupational health-worksite clearance, including emergency exits, electrical safety, and employee welfare facilities.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Oman Tax Authority (OTA; هيئة الضرائب) — national e-services portal: https://taxoman.gov.om. Import/export declarations are administered by the national customs authority through the Bayan single-window system built on ASYCUDA World.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1 — Incorporate the Single Person Company (SPC) with the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MoCIIP) via the Invest Easy portal; obtain the Commercial Registration (CR) with the applicable ISIC 4651 wholesale description. Step 2 — Apply for income tax registration and obtain the Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) from the OTA within 30 days of commencement of business or of the CR date, whichever is earlier (Income Tax Law, Royal Decree 28/2009, as amended). Step 3 — Submit the mandatory VAT registration application through the same OTA e-services account if annual taxable supplies (including imports) meet the OMR 500,000 mandatory threshold or OMR 250,000 voluntary threshold; importers register without regard to turnover. Step 4 — Register as a customs trader in the Bayan/ASYCUDA World system to obtain the customs/PC number used on export declarations. Step 5 — For a foreign-owned SPC with a non-resident sole shareholder, file the electronic foreign-investment ownership declaration required by Invest Easy and verify withholding tax/permanent establishment filing obligations; a non-resident without an Oman establishment that supplies Oman must register for VAT and, when required by OTA, appoint a tax representative in Oman.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation — An Omani SPC is a separate juridical person under the Commercial Companies Law (Royal Decree 18/2019) and a resident corporate taxpayer under Article 2(1) of the Income Tax Law. It is taxed in its own name at 15% on worldwide income from wholesale trading; no partnership-style pass-through or fiscal transparency applies to the sole shareholder. The SPC is also the VAT person for Omani VAT purposes; its CR number and TIN are the sole identity anchor in the OTA database.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Oman (CBO) with the Foreign Exchange Circulars issued under the Banking Law (Royal Decree 114/2000) and the Foreign Exchange Policy administered through licensed banks and exchange houses; currency is the Omani Rial (OMR) pegged to the USD at 1 OMR = 2.6008 USD.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Oman maintains a fully convertible current account regime under IMF Article VIII obligations, with no material restrictions on payments for imports, exports, interest, dividends, or service fees; capital account transactions are liberalized for direct investment, and 100% foreign ownership is permitted in most non-strategic sectors. Profit remittance is allowed freely through commercial banks, subject to anti-money laundering verification and a withholding tax settlement certificate; no profit transfer tax applies on distributions to non-resident shareholders absent a PE. Certain strategic sectors (e.g., telecom, banking, insurance) retain licensing and ownership caps. For semiconductor wholesale brokerage (ISIC 4651), no exchange control permit is required for current account settlement, but banks require the underlying trade invoice, customs declaration, or contract for processing.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Oman does not impose mandatory export proceeds surrender or conversion ratios; exporters may retain and use foreign currency earnings, but commercial banks must report cross-border transactions to the CBO for statistical and AML/CFT purposes. All export receipts should be received within the contractual payment terms, and in practice banks require an Export Declaration (from the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion) and a bill of lading or airway bill for reconciliation; no statutory timeline applies beyond the normal 90-day or 180-day trade credit periods, though any prolonged delay triggers enhanced due diligence by the bank.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: LOW for offshore digital EMIs and virtual account providers. Oman does not license foreign electronic money institutions or payment service providers as banks; only CBO-licensed commercial banks and exchange houses can provide corporate settlement accounts in OMR. Offshore EMI accounts (e.g., Wise, Mercury, Airwallex) are not acceptable for statutory escrow or capital injection; they may serve as auxiliary receivable collection channels but cannot handle OMR clearing or official trade documentary settlements without violating CBO circulars. Any digital EMI must partner through a licensed local bank under a CBO-approved white-label arrangement, but onboarding complexity and compliance risk are high; recommended approach is a direct tier-1 bank relationship.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Omani commercial banks require physical presence of all directors, shareholders, and authorized signatories for account opening in virtually all cases, especially for a newly formed Single Person Company (SPC). Some banks may offer electronic pre-screening, but final KYC interview and wet-ink or e-signature certification require an in-person visit to the branch, or a recognized relationship manager visit to the client's office in Oman. For a foreign-owned SPC, the shareholder-director must appear in person or execute a Power of Attorney (notarized and apostilled) appointing a resident manager; however, even with a POA, banks insist on at least one physical meeting with the economic owner or the appointed Oman-resident manager before the account is activated.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk jurisdiction perception for the beneficial owner (non-GCC residence, especially jurisdictions with weak AML regimes or high cryptocurrency exposure)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Passport copy; utility bill; bank reference letter from the home-country bank of the ultimate beneficial owner; source-of-wealth statement signed by the owner; audited financials or opening balance-sheet declaration; proof of registered office in Oman; company's business plan and invoice from a semiconductor supplier; AML/CFT policy manual if the entity has staff; and an explanation of the commercial route for SSD/CPU wholesale transactions.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Mismatch between declared business activities and transaction profile (brokerage of high-value, easily transportable semiconductor goods creates a smuggling or trade-based money laundering red flag)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Actual signed contracts with the counterparty (distributor or end-user); pro-forma invoices from upstream suppliers (e.g., Intel, Samsung, SK Hynix, or authorized distributors); customs declaration and airway bill / bill of lading; tax identification numbers of counterparties; expected monthly volume and value assessment; and undertaking that all transactions will be backed by irrevocable LC or TT with inspection certificate.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unclear rationale for 100% foreign ownership without physical office or resident manager
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Office lease agreement in Oman; Oman Chamber of Commerce registration (commercial registration, CR); Qatar? No, Oman Municipal/Investment Authority trade license; appointment of a local registered manager with a valid Omani residence card; explanation of the SPC's independent management; and a letter of comfort from the parent company or shareholder, if any.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Expected high-throughput wire activity with multiple counterparties in third-party jurisdictions (trade-based money laundering concern)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full counterparty KYC files (certificate of incorporation, director passport, bank details); transaction look-back chart for the last 12 months (if existing); sanctions screening policies; a restricted list of jurisdictions not to be used; and an agreement to provide a monthly TBML red-flag review to the bank.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant routing for the SPC's initial capital and subsequent shareholder loans: shareholder must remit funds via SWIFT MT103 from a bank account in the shareholder's country, using purpose code 'Capital Increase in Resident Enterprise' (Omani bank mapping to code 7 - Direct Investment Capital Contribution) or 'Shareholder Loan' for debt-like injections. The bank will require a board resolution, the CR (commercial registration), the signed articles of association, and an opening capital certificate. The OMR equivalent is credited after conversion at the prevailing CBO exchange rate; no prior approval is required for a 100% foreign-owned SPC in wholesale trade. For large injections (above OMR 1 million), the bank may request the source-of-funds evidence and the underlying business contract to support the wire narrative. For buy-side trade inflows, each remittance must include a clear narrative of the goods description (SSD modules, CPU chips), the invoice number, and the LC reference, enabling the bank to match payments to customs declarations.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary clearing rails: (1) SWIFT MT103 for direct wire transfers to suppliers or licensed distributors in jurisdictions such as UAE, Singapore, Taiwan, China, or the US; (2) Commercial Letter of Credit (L/C) issued through Oman commercial banks, either irrevocable at sight or with a deferred payment date, for high-value procurement above USD 250,000; (3) Documentary Collection (D/P or D/A) for lower-value repeat shipments; (4) Escrow inspection wire through a third-party escrow service — acceptable only if the escrow provider is an international bank or licensed trust company with a clear audit trail, and the Omani bank receives the escrow agreement for monitoring. For outbound trade disbursements, banks require the commercial invoice, packing list, and pro-forma supplier details; the exporter must also obtain an Export Declaration for any shipment valued over OMR 3,000. Omani banks do not operate a separate real-time gross settlement system for trade; they use the Oman Automated Clearing House (OACH) for local settlement in OMR, but cross-border transactions must route via SWIFT or the UAE's UAE? no, strictly SWIFT for international.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Spot foreign exchange contracts with any CBO-licensed commercial bank for same-day or T+2 settlement
Outright forward contracts (tenor 1 to 12 months) for USD/OMR — natural hedge because OMR is pegged to USD; available at major banks with unsecured lines or collateral
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) for non-USD major currencies (EUR, GBP, JPY, CNY) to hedge procurement in those currencies; Omani banks quote NDFs with reference to a designated fixing source
Foreign currency swaps (fixed-to-fixed or floating-to-fixed) for longer-term asset-liability matching on capital injections or supplier pre-payments
Cross-currency interest rate swaps may be available for sophisticated counterparties, but require CBO or bank-specific documentation under ISDA/CSA; not typically needed for spot trading models
No exchange-traded FX options are permissible unless arranged via a licensed dealer; Omani banks may structure vanilla FX options on a case-by-case basis

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MOCIIP) – Commercial Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due during the 30 days preceding the CR expiry date, i.e., the anniversary of the initial registration month.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal fine of OMR 50 for the first month and OMR 100 for each additional month; prolonged non-renewal leads to administrative strike-off of the commercial registration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 3 months after the end of the financial year (e.g., by 31 March for a 31 December year-end).
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file may result in statutory penalties under the Commercial Companies Law (RD 18/2019), including fines on the company and directors and suspension of the commercial registration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 4 months after the end of the tax period (e.g., by 30 April for a calendar-year taxpayer).
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of OMR 100 plus OMR 10 per day of delay; unpaid tax accrues monthly interest at 1.5%; enforcement may include bank account restrictions and asset seizures.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Chamber of Commerce Membership Renewal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Oman Chamber of Commerce and Industry (OCCI)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Concurrent with CR renewal, typically before the CR anniversary date.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-renewal suspends the member's legal capacity to operate, may trigger CR cancellation, and late fees apply.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: All Oman Single Person Companies (SPCs) are required to appoint a certified independent auditor and file audited financial statements, irrespective of turnover, assets, or number of shareholders. No size-based exemption exists under the Commercial Companies Law (RD 18/2019).
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS); smaller entities may adopt IFRS for SMEs where permitted by the Oman Association of Certified Public Accountants.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under the Beneficial Owner Regulations (Ministerial Decision 84/2019), the SPC must maintain a register of beneficial owners at the registered office and file any changes with MOCIIP within 15 days. Annual confirmation of the UBO register is submitted as part of the CR renewal process, affirming that shareholding and beneficial ownership details remain accurate.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,500 – 5,000 (depending on transaction volumes and audit complexity)

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 15% on taxable income under the Oman Income Tax Law (Royal Decree 28/2009, as amended). A reduced 3% rate applies only to the first OMR 100,000 of taxable income of qualifying small taxpayers and is generally unavailable to a 100% foreign-owned Single Person Company.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No automatic statutory exemption for an onshore wholesale SSD/CPU brokerage. Targeted relief arises only (i) if the SPC holds a qualifying license inside a designated free zone (e.g., Duqm SEZ, Sohar Free Zone, Salalah Free Trade Zone), where CIT exemptions of 10 to 30 years are available for qualifying activities with genuine substance, or (ii) via project-specific incentives under the Investment Promotion Law (Royal Decree 50/2022) for export-oriented or employment-creating logistics/warehousing operations. Absent such status, the effective rate approximates the 15% statutory rate after ordinary declared deductions (COGS, commissions, freight, banking and compliance costs).
